sourceCopy.name: Lease vs Buy Car Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Lease vs Buy Car Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Compare car lease and purchase costs over your use period, including mileage, maintenance and resale value. Free, private, no account.
sourceCopy.intro: Compare estimated cash costs over the same vehicle-use period. Enter matching assumptions; financing, insurance and fuel are not modeled.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I compare leasing and buying a car?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: For a lease, add payments, money due at signing, end fees, excess-mile charges and maintenance. For buying, subtract expected resale value from purchase price, taxes/fees and maintenance. Compare totals over the same number of months.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Are my car and cost details uploaded?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The estimate runs in this browser and does not request quotes or contact a dealer.

additionalFaqs.question: How does the mileage allowance affect a lease?
additionalFaqs.answer: Only miles above the annual allowance are multiplied by the per-mile fee. This simplified estimate assumes annual mileage is steady over the selected term.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the buy estimate include resale value?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. It subtracts your entered expected resale value from purchase price, taxes/fees and maintenance. Resale value is uncertain, so try a range of estimates.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this include financing or loan interest?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It compares cash ownership costs and depreciation, not loan amortization, lease money factor, insurance, fuel, registration differences or taxes beyond the purchase amount you enter.

fields.months: Months you expect to use the car
fields.assumptions: Use the same time period and currency for both choices. Enter your best estimate for end value and mileage.
fields.accuracyNote: Estimate only. Financing interest, loan balance, lease money factor, insurance, fuel, taxes not entered, wear charges and changing values are excluded. Not a quote or financial advice.

messages.checkInputs: Check terms, mileage, costs and resale value.
messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is unavailable in this browser.
